name: Pineapple, Beef & Ginger Stir-Fry with Cauliflower Rice

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium head cauliflower
½ small pineapple
1 (2 ½ cm) piece ginger root
½ small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Trim off the ends from the pineapple and cut off the skin, then cut lengthwise into 2 sections and cut out the cores; cut each section into bite-sized chunks and transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger; transfer to a small bowl.
Trim off and discard the stem end and leaves of the cauliflower; cut the head into larger pieces and, using a box grater, coarsely grate the pieces into rice-like texture.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into 6-mm pieces at an angle and transfer to a small bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add the grated cauliflower to the skillet and season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until it has softened, 4 to 5 minutes. Once done, transfer to a bowl and tent with foil to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the cauliflower cooks, pat dry the steak with paper towels, then thinly slice crosswise (against the grain) into bite-sized strips.
Once the cauliflower has been transferred, increase the heat to medium-high.
Add more coconut oil and the steak slices to the skillet; cook, tossing occasionally, until the pieces are nicely browned, 3 to 4 minutes total. Once done, transfer to a bowl.
While the steak cooks, in a small bowl, whisk together cornstarch with 2 tsp of water, then add soy sauce, rice vinegar, and honey and whisk again.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp cornstarch
2 tbsp soy sauce
½ tbsp rice vinegar
1 tsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Once the steak has been transferred, add more coconut oil and the ginger to the skillet; cook until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the pineapple to the skillet; cook until heated through, 30 seconds to 1 minute.

Return the steak to the skillet, add ½ of the green onions (save the rest for garnishing), and pour the sauce over top. Stir-fry until the steak slices and pineapple chunks are coated in the sauce and the sauce has thickened, 1 to 2 minutes.
To serve, place the cauliflower rice into a bowl, top with the stir-fry, and garnish with the remaining green onions. Enjoy!
